description: Issue #839 AC4, the Turtle & Rendering half of "nothing shadows": `define forward :n … print 999 … end` then `forward 10`. Phase-1 registration raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`), matching what `check()` reports. The empty event stream is the assertion that matters: a `print` payload of `999` would mean the shadow is back, and a `move` payload would mean the primitive silently won instead. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
